id: title:brandonleung:mint ai gateway tokens for posthog ai sandbox runs

review.posthog_relevance: Adds configuration and model association support for the 'posthog_ai' product, including token minting and sandbox token caps.
review.reason: The chunk adds configuration entries and model associations for the 'posthog_ai' product. P1.F3.H1 adds the product to the sandbox token cap and minting configuration, while P1.F2.H1 associates it with first-party agent models. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement for the AI product, establishing the relationship between the product and its supported models
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of the actual AI product, the definition of allowed models, or the configuration of the sandbox token cap. The tier cannot be established without seeing the actual product registration and the model catalog.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the new 'posthog_ai' product, the definition of its allowed models, or the configuration of its sandbox token cap. It only shows configuration and test additions. The tier cannot be established without seeing the actual product registration and the model catalog. No score is assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds 'posthog_ai' to the sandbox token cap configuration, allowing it to be set via environment variable.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to configure a token spending cap for the posthog_ai product, which could prevent runaway costs if the product is not properly gated.

observations.behavior: Adds 'posthog_ai' to the list of products allowed to use first-party agent models.
observations.posthog_connection: Associates the posthog_ai product with a catalog of allowed AI models, establishing the relationship between the product and its supported models.

observations.behavior: Adds 'posthog_ai' to the set of products that can mint tokens, with a comment noting it is API-settable and bills the team's own credits.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the posthog_ai product to request and mint its own tokens, while the implementation checks the team's credit balance before minting.
